name: Colorado Native Electric
old_description: Welcome! My name is Donlin, my wife and I own and run Colorado Native Electric as a local small business that specializes in custom electrical projects. My wife and I are both born and raised in beautiful Colorado so we know the area quite well. Personally having 10+ years of experience as an electrician, I understand the importance of detailed work. Our goal is to complete each job with high quality and safety, along with competitive pricing. Whether you're needing a simple replacement or building your dream home, we'd love to help you out!
about:
Colorado Native Electric operates from Indian Hills, Colorado, serving the greater Littleton area. The company was founded by Donlin and his wife, both Colorado natives, who run the business as a family-owned small enterprise. Donlin brings over ten years of experience as a licensed electrician to the operation.

The firm provides custom electrical project services for residential customers, handling work that ranges from simple fixture replacements to complete rewiring and inspection-related repairs. Projects are executed by the owner-operator team without subcontracting, allowing direct oversight of each job site.

Homeowners and property sellers in the Front Range region make up the primary client base. Testimonials reference rewiring rooms, addressing inspection items during home sales, and general electrical repairs, indicating a focus on single-family residential work.

The owners emphasize competitive pricing, high-quality workmanship, and safety compliance as the foundation of their approach, aiming to make the process straightforward for clients who need reliable electrical service.
